  have hz0 : 0 < z := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min ha hb) hz.1

  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul,density]

/-- The source-normalized pole period is exactly the finite moving-endpoint integral. -/
theorem sourcePeriod_eq_clockPeriod (delta : ℂ) (h : ℝ) :
    sourcePeriod delta h = clockPeriod delta h := by
  have hc := Real.exp_pos (-h)
  have hinv : 1/Real.exp (-h) = Real.exp h := by rw [Real.exp_neg]; simp
  have hlo : (1+Real.exp (-h))/(2*Real.exp (-h)) = lower h := by
    unfold lower
    have he := Real.exp_ne_zero (-h)
    calc
      (1+Real.exp (-h))/(2*Real.exp (-h)) = (1/Real.exp (-h)+1)/2 := by field_simp
      _ = _ := by rw [hinv]
  rw [sourcePeriod,poleMoment_one_rescale (delta-2) hc,hlo,hinv]
  have hp : power (4-delta) (Real.exp (-h))*power (delta-2) (Real.exp (-h)) =
      (Real.exp (-2*h):ℂ) := by
    simp only [power,Real.log_exp,← Complex.exp_add]
    rw [Complex.ofReal_exp]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← mul_assoc,hp]
  rfl

    HasDerivAt (sourcePeriod delta)

  have he : sourcePeriod delta = clockPeriod delta := funext (sourcePeriod_eq_clockPeriod delta)
  rw [he]
  exact clockPeriod_hasDerivAt delta hh

/-!
# The two edge powers at the balanced height

At `T = chebHeightOne x` the two trivial sizes of the Chebyshev contour bound separate into the
cutoff itself times an explicit factor, and both separations are *exact*:

```text
x^{c(T)} = x · exp(-√(log x)/80000),      x^{d(T)} = x · exp(-(3/2)√(log x)) · T.
```

The first is the left edge's saving; the second is what the truncation height `T` absorbs.
-/

namespace RHTower.Sieve

/-- The right-edge power, split off from the trivial size. -/
theorem rpow_chebRightTwo {T x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ chebRightTwo T = x * Real.exp (1 / Real.log T * Real.log x) := by
  rw [chebRightTwo, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx,
    show Real.log x * (1 + 1 / Real.log T) = Real.log x + 1 / Real.log T * Real.log x by ring,
    Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hx]

/-- The left-edge power, split off from the trivial size. -/
theorem rpow_chebLeftTwo {T x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ chebLeftTwo T = x * Real.exp (-(1 / 40000 / Real.log T) * Real.log x) := by
  rw [chebLeftTwo, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx,
    show Real.log x * (1 - 1 / 40000 / Real.log T)
      = Real.log x + -(1 / 40000 / Real.log T) * Real.log x by ring,
    Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hx]

/-- **The left-edge power at the balanced height.** -/
theorem rpow_chebLeftTwo_at {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : 16 ≤ Real.log x) :
    x ^ chebLeftTwo (chebHeightOne x) = x * Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (Real.log x) / 80000)) := by
  rw [rpow_chebLeftTwo hx0]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  have h := saving_exponent_one hx
  linarith [h]

/-- **The right-edge power at the balanced height.** -/
theorem rpow_chebRightTwo_at {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : 16 ≤ Real.log x) :
    x ^ chebRightTwo (chebHeightOne x)
      = x * (Real.exp (-(3 / 2) * Real.sqrt (Real.log x)) * chebHeightOne x) := by
  rw [rpow_chebRightTwo hx0, exp_right_le_chebHeightOne hx]

end RHTower.Sieve

open Complex Set Filter Topology

private theorem paired_power_norm (w : ℂ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    ‖power (w/2) z‖*‖power (w/2) z‖=z^w.re := by
  rw [power,Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hz]
  rw [← Real.rpow_add hz]
  congr 1
  simp

/-- The true horizon Green integrand decays by z^Re(w), uniformly up to AdS. -/
theorem horizon_source_bound {w chi : ℂ} (h : Chamber w chi) (s a J K T : ℂ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, z ∈ Ioo 0 1 →
      ‖horizon w chi z*sourceProfile s w a J K T z‖ ≤ C*z^w.re := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hF⟩ := horizonFactor_bound h
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hR⟩ := sourceRemainder_bound s w a J K T
  refine ⟨D*C,mul_nonneg hD hC,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hprod := mul_le_mul (hF z ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩) (hR z ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩) (norm_nonneg _) hD
  calc
    ‖horizon w chi z*sourceProfile s w a J K T z‖ =
        (‖power (w/2) z‖*‖power (w/2) z‖)*
          (‖gaussFactor w chi false z‖*‖sourceRemainder s w a J K T z‖) := by
      simp only [horizon,dress,sourceProfile,norm_mul]
      ring
    _ ≤ (D*C)*z^w.re := by
      rw [paired_power_norm w hz.1,mul_comm (D*C)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (Real.rpow_nonneg hz.1.le _)

/-- The true outer Green integrand has an integrable power bound whenever
Re(w) ≤ k+1 < Re(w)+1; no resonance is discarded. -/
theorem normalizable_source_bound {w chi : ℂ} (h : Chamber w chi) (s a J K T : ℂ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : w.re-1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, z ∈ Ioo 0 1 →
      ‖normalizable w chi z*sourceProfile s w a J K T z‖ ≤ C*z^(w.re-(k+1:ℕ)) := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hF⟩ := outerFactor_bound h k hk
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hR⟩ := sourceRemainder_bound s w a J K T
  refine ⟨D*C,mul_nonneg hD hC,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hs : ‖power (1/2) (1-z)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [power_half_eq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2.le),Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_one).mpr (by linarith [hz.1])
  have hFR := mul_le_mul (hF z hz) (hR z ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩) (norm_nonneg _)
    (div_nonneg hD (pow_nonneg hz.1.le _))
  have hSFR : ‖power (1/2) (1-z)‖*(‖gaussFactor w chi true (1-z)‖*
      ‖sourceRemainder s w a J K T z‖) ≤ D/z^(k+1)*C := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul hs hFR (by positivity) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)
  calc
    ‖normalizable w chi z*sourceProfile s w a J K T z‖ =
        (‖power (w/2) z‖*‖power (w/2) z‖)*
          (‖power (1/2) (1-z)‖*(‖gaussFactor w chi true (1-z)‖*
            ‖sourceRemainder s w a J K T z‖)) := by
      simp only [normalizable,dress,outerFactor,sourceProfile,norm_mul]
      ring
    _ ≤ z^w.re*(D/z^(k+1)*C) := by
      rw [paired_power_norm w hz.1]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSFR (Real.rpow_nonneg hz.1.le _)
    _ = (D*C)*z^(w.re-(k+1:ℕ)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hz.1,Real.rpow_natCast]
      ring

end
end RHTower.D4BMLaplaceRadial

    {u t m : ℕ} {W Z y h : ℝ}

    (htBand : ∀ p ∈ t.primeFactors, (W : ℝ) < p ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ Z)
    (hmOutside : ∀ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ¬ ((W : ℝ) < p ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ Z))

    (hmSign : mobiusComplexCoefficient m = -(1 : ℂ))
    (hmGap : |(m : ℝ) - y| ≤ h) :
    (t * m).primeFactors.card = t.primeFactors.card + 3 ∧
      (t * m).primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => W < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ Z) = t.primeFactors ∧
      mobiusComplexCoefficient (t * m) = -mobiusComplexCoefficient u ∧
      |(t : ℝ) * m - (t : ℝ) * y| ≤ (t : ℝ) * h

    (hmOutside : ∀ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ¬ ((W : ℝ) < p ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ Z))
    (htSign : mobiusComplexCoefficient t = mobiusComplexCoefficient u)
    (hmSign : mobiusComplexCoefficient m = -(1 : ℂ))

      (t * m).primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => W < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ Z) = t.primeFactors ∧

theorem tsum_incidenceUpper {ω δ : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∑' d : ℕ, incidenceUpper ω δ t d

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem tsum_incidenceUpper {ω δ : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∑' d : ℕ, incidenceUpper ω δ t d
      = (1 / (1 + ω)) * Real.exp (-(δ * t)) * mobiusShiftTail ω ⌊Real.exp t⌋₊
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  set N : ℕ := ⌊Real.exp t⌋₊ with hN
  have hsum := (summable_incidenceUpper (δ := δ) hω t).sum_add_tsum_nat_add N
  have hhead : ∑ d ∈ Finset.range N, incidenceUpper ω δ t d = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun d hd => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hd
    rw [incidenceUpper_eq ht d, if_pos (by omega)]
  rw [hhead, zero_add] at hsum
  rw [← hsum, mobiusShiftTail, ← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun i => ?_
  rw [incidenceUpper_eq ht (i + N), if_neg (by omega)]
  have hcast : ((i + N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((i + (N + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := rfl
  have hcast2 : moebius (i + N + 1) = moebius (i + (N + 1)) := rfl
  rw [hcast, hcast2]

source_arguments.name: GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.DifferentialAlgEquiv.not_unit_eigenvector_and_translate_one_on_generators
source_arguments.statement:
theorem DifferentialAlgEquiv.not_unit_eigenvector_and_translate_one_on_generators
    (sigma : DifferentialAlgEquiv C T)
    (q r : T) (hq : HypertranscendentalOver C q)
    (hr : HypertranscendentalOver C r)
    (hqgen : differentialAdjoin C ({q} : Set T) = ⊤)
    (hrgen : differentialAdjoin C ({r} : Set T) = ⊤)
    (lam : Cˣ)
    (hqaction : sigma.toAlgEquiv q = q * algebraMap C T (lam : C))
    (hraction : sigma.toAlgEquiv r = r + algebraMap C T 1) : False
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem DifferentialAlgEquiv.not_unit_eigenvector_and_translate_one_on_generators
    (sigma : DifferentialAlgEquiv C T)
    (q r : T) (hq : HypertranscendentalOver C q)
    (hr : HypertranscendentalOver C r)
    (hqgen : differentialAdjoin C ({q} : Set T) = ⊤)
    (hrgen : differentialAdjoin C ({r} : Set T) = ⊤)
    (lam : Cˣ)
    (hqaction : sigma.toAlgEquiv q = q * algebraMap C T (lam : C))
    (hraction : sigma.toAlgEquiv r = r + algebraMap C T 1) : False
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hqr : q ∈ differentialAdjoin C ({r} : Set T) := by
    rw [hrgen]
    trivial
  have hrq : r ∈ differentialAdjoin C ({q} : Set T) := by
    rw [hqgen]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨A, B, c, d, hdet, hmob⟩ := mutual_generator_mobius hq hr hrq hqr
  let AT : T := algebraMap C T A
  let BT : T := algebraMap C T B
  let cT : T := algebraMap C T c
  let dT : T := algebraMap C T d
  let lamT : T := algebraMap C T (lam : C)
  have hmobT : r * (cT * q + dT) = AT * q + BT := by
    simpa [AT, BT, cT, dT] using hmob
  have hmobSigma :
      (r + 1) * (cT * (q * lamT) + dT) = AT * (q * lamT) + BT := by
    have hs := congrArg sigma.toAlgEquiv hmobT
    simpa [AT, BT, cT, dT, lamT, hqaction, hraction, map_add, map_mul,
      sigma.toAlgEquiv.commutes] using hs
  let D0 : T := cT * q + dT
  let D1 : T := cT * (q * lamT) + dT
  let N0 : T := AT * q + BT
  let N1 : T := AT * (q * lamT) + BT
  have hmob0 : r * D0 = N0 := by simpa [D0, N0] using hmobT
  have hmob1 : (r + 1) * D1 = N1 := by simpa [D1, N1] using hmobSigma
  have hshift0 : (r + 1) * D0 = N0 + D0 := by
    calc
      (r + 1) * D0 = r * D0 + D0 := by ring
      _ = N0 + D0 := by rw [hmob0]
  have hclear : (N0 + D0) * D1 - N1 * D0 = 0 := by
    calc
      (N0 + D0) * D1 - N1 * D0 = ((r + 1) * D0) * D1 - N1 * D0 := by
        rw [hshift0]
      _ = ((r + 1) * D1) * D0 - N1 * D0 := by ring
      _ = N1 * D0 - N1 * D0 := by rw [hmob1]
      _ = 0 := sub_self _
  let P : C[X] :=
    Polynomial.monomial 2 (c * c * (lam : C)) +
      Polynomial.monomial 1 ((1 - (lam : C)) * (A * d - B * c) +
        c * d * (1 + (lam : C))) +
      Polynomial.C (d * d)
  have hPeval : Polynomial.aeval q P = 0 := by
    have hexpand : Polynomial.aeval q P = (N0 + D0) * D1 - N1 * D0 := by
      simp [P, N0, N1, D0, D1, AT, BT, cT, dT, lamT]
      ring
    rw [hexpand]
    exact hclear
  have hqtrans : Transcendental C q := by
    simpa using hypertranscendentalOver_jet_transcendental hq 0
  have hPzero : P = 0 := by
    by_contra hP
    exact hqtrans ⟨P, hP, hPeval⟩
  have hd2 : d * d = 0 := by
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun Q : C[X] => Q.coeff 0) hPzero
    simpa [P, Polynomial.coeff_monomial] using hcoeff
  have hd : d = 0 := (mul_self_eq_zero.mp hd2)
  have hc : c = 0 := by
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun Q : C[X] => Q.coeff 2) hPzero
    simpa [P, hd, Polynomial.coeff_monomial] using hcoeff
  apply hdet
  simp [hc, hd]

obligations: prove that d = 0 and c = 0
use determinant condition to conclude False
evidence: obtain ⟨A, B, c, d, hdet, hmob⟩ := mutual_generator_mobius hq hr hrq hqr

## Mission and success condition

Resume the Connes–Consani–Moscovici lane, guided by Lean as the authoritative research corpus.

1. `[LEAN-PROVED]` unconditional
   `P_-(L) ≤ C_Γ(L) + P_+(L)` for every `L ≥ π/2`, hence RH;
2. a concrete proved violating `L`, hence disproof of RH;
3. an unconditional theorem excluding every CCM-admissible infinite source transport.

Do not count equivalent RH criteria, estimates, infrastructure, or another excluded subclass.
Use `hgt-fields-medalist`; read `docs/meta/scientific-method.md` and failed-route cards first.

## Exact endpoint already closed in Lean

For finite right-half-plane nodes `P`, the required object is

W_P = [[G_P, r_P], [r_Pᴴ, 4]],

4. **Invert one prime at a time.** Every step is invertible, but (6) proves the cofinal inverse is
   not uniformly conditioned.
5. **Use Buchstab/fundamental-lemma positivity.** Existing corpus already locates a surviving
   balanced Type-II chamber.  The synchronized block theorem is its critical translation analogue:
   positive norms preserve rather than cancel that chamber.

/-!
# Plancherel for the causal Laplace transform on the imaginary axis

The corpus already carries the exact Mellin--Plancherel line law.  In logarithmic coordinates the
Mellin trace on `Re s = 0` *is* the Laplace transform on the imaginary axis, so the same law reads

```text
∫_R ‖(L g)(i y)‖² dy = 2 π ∫_R ‖g(u)‖² du
```

for every `g ∈ L¹ ∩ L²(R)`.  Applied to a causal `g` (supported on `[0,∞)`) this is the
Paley--Wiener energy identity used by the centered-boundary and causal-graph laws.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology

noncomputable section
namespace RHTower

/-- The Laplace transform of `g` evaluated on the imaginary axis. -/
def laplaceBoundary (g : ℝ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ u : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ)) * g u

theorem logMellinLineSource_log_comp (g : ℝ → ℂ) :
    logMellinLineSource (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) 0 = g := by
  funext u
  rw [logMellinLineSource, Real.log_exp]
  simp

theorem mellin_log_comp_eq_laplaceBoundary (g : ℝ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) :
    mellin (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = laplaceBoundary g y := by
  rw [mellin_eq_integral_exp_neg_mul_log, laplaceBoundary]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [] with u
  rw [Real.log_exp]
  congr 2
  · push_cast
    ring
  · norm_num

/-- **Plancherel for the boundary Laplace transform.** -/
theorem integral_norm_sq_laplaceBoundary
    {g : ℝ → ℂ} (h1 : Integrable g) (h2 : MemLp g 2 volume) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, ‖laplaceBoundary g y‖ ^ 2) = 2 * Real.pi * ∫ u : ℝ, ‖g u‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hsrc := logMellinLineSource_log_comp g
  have h1' : Integrable (logMellinLineSource (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) 0) := by
    rw [hsrc]; exact h1
  have h2' : MemLp (logMellinLineSource (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) 0) 2 volume := by
    rw [hsrc]; exact h2
  have hmain := integral_norm_sq_mellin_line_eq_logMellinLineSource h1' h2'
  rw [hsrc] at hmain
  rw [← hmain]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [] with y
  rw [mellin_log_comp_eq_laplaceBoundary]

/-- **Integrability companion.** -/
theorem integrable_norm_sq_laplaceBoundary
    {g : ℝ → ℂ} (h1 : Integrable g) (h2 : MemLp g 2 volume) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => ‖laplaceBoundary g y‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hsrc := logMellinLineSource_log_comp g
  have h1' : Integrable (logMellinLineSource (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) 0) := by
    rw [hsrc]; exact h1
  have h2' : MemLp (logMellinLineSource (fun x : ℝ => g (-Real.log x)) 0) 2 volume := by
    rw [hsrc]; exact h2
  have hmain := integrable_norm_sq_mellin_line_of_logMellinLineSource h1' h2'
  refine hmain.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [] with y
  rw [mellin_log_comp_eq_laplaceBoundary]

/-- Linearity of the boundary transform on integrable inputs. -/
theorem laplaceBoundary_sub {g h : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : Integrable g) (hh : Integrable h) (y : ℝ) :
    laplaceBoundary (fun u => g u - h u) y = laplaceBoundary g y - laplaceBoundary h y := by
  have hgi : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ)) * g u) := by
    refine hg.bdd_mul (c := 1) ?_ ?_
    · exact (by fun_prop :
        Measurable fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [] with u
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre : (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ)).re = 0 := by
        simp [Complex.mul_re]
      rw [hre]
      norm_num
  have hhi : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ)) * h u) := by
    refine hh.bdd_mul (c := 1) ?_ ?_
    · exact (by fun_prop :
        Measurable fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [] with u
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre : (-((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (u : ℂ)).re = 0 := by
        simp [Complex.mul_re]
      rw [hre]
      norm_num
  rw [laplaceBoundary, laplaceBoundary, laplaceBoundary, ← integral_sub hgi hhi]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [] with u
  ring

end RHTower

      cuspMainLaplaceVector q branch a w (by have := causalPrincipalThreshold_pos q; linarith)+
        ∑ i : Fin 3, principalCutoffSpatialOp q i (principalTimeLaplace q branch a i w) := by
  have hw₀ : -2 < w.re := by have := causalPrincipalThreshold_pos q; linarith
  have hi (i : Fin 3) := principalCutoffTimeVector_laplace_integrable q branch a i w
    ((principalResponseGrowth_lt_threshold q i).trans hw)

    integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i),timeCuspMainVector_laplace q branch a w hw₀]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

/-!
# Exponentially sharpened Morse--Fisher envelope

The endpoint estimate for the Fisher residual discards the exact decay of the Morse quotient.
For the first theta atom that quotient is bounded by its endpoint excess times `exp (-2x)`.
The global quadratic Taylor majorant for this exponential gives a polynomial-moment upper value
that is strictly sharper than the endpoint value on the source-dominant region.

This file proves the analytic estimate and its integral transport.  It does not assert the final
finite numerical moment certificate.
-/

open Real MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology Polynomial

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- The endpoint excess in the first-atom Morse quotient. -/
def thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor : ℝ :=
  (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.pi - 3 / 2)

/-- The exact decaying envelope extracted from the first-atom Morse quotient. -/
def thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherExponentialEnvelope (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor * Real.exp (-2 * x)

/-- The quadratic upper Taylor section used after the exact exponential decay extraction. -/
def thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherQuadraticEnvelope (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor * (1 - 2 * x + 2 * x ^ 2)

/-- The first Morse weight retains the full `exp (2x)` growth of its endpoint gap. -/
theorem thetaCuspFirstAtom_morseWeight_exponential_floor
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (Real.pi - 3 / 2) * Real.exp (2 * x) ≤
      thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x - 3 / 2 := by
  have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * x) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have heq : thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x = Real.pi * Real.exp (2 * x) := by
    rw [thetaCuspMorseScale]
    norm_num
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith

/-- Exact source-specific decay of the Fisher quotient away from the half-line endpoint. -/
theorem thetaCuspFirstAtom_morseScale_div_weight_le_exponential
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x / thetaCuspBornWittenWeight 1 x ≤
      1 + thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor * Real.exp (-2 * x) := by
  let t := thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x
  let a := Real.pi - 3 / 2
  let e := Real.exp (2 * x)
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have he : 0 < e := by
    dsimp [e]
    positivity
  have hfloor : a * e ≤ t - 3 / 2 := by
    simpa only [a, e, t] using
      thetaCuspFirstAtom_morseWeight_exponential_floor hx
  have hq : 0 < t - 3 / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos ha he) hfloor
  have hfrac : (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (t - 3 / 2) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (a * e) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (mul_pos ha he) hfloor
  have hexpneg : Real.exp (-2 * x) = e⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [e]
    rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hrewrite : (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (a * e) =
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) / a) * Real.exp (-2 * x) := by
    rw [hexpneg]
    field_simp
  rw [thetaCuspBornWittenWeight_eq]
  dsimp [t] at hq hfrac ⊢
  rw [show thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x /
        (thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x - 3 / 2) =
      1 + (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x - 3 / 2) by
    conv_lhs =>
      congr
      · rw [show thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x =
          (thetaCuspMorseScale 1 x - 3 / 2) + 3 / 2 by ring]
    rw [add_div, div_self hq.ne']]
  rw [hrewrite] at hfrac
  simpa only [thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor, a, add_comm] using
    add_le_add_left hfrac 1

theorem thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor_pos :
    0 < thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor := by
  rw [thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor]
  exact div_pos (by norm_num) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three])

theorem thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherEndpointFactor_eq_one_add_decayFactor :
    thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherEndpointFactor =
      1 + thetaCuspFirstAtomMorseFisherDecayFactor := by

/-!
# The exterior oscillatory primitive

An oscillatory integral over an unbounded range is bounded uniformly in the endpoint as soon as the
antiderivative datum of the integration by parts decays like `1/x` and its derivative like `1/x²`.
The boundary terms are then bounded by the value at the left endpoint and the remaining integral by
the convergent tail `∫ x⁻² `, both independently of the right endpoint.

This is the exterior counterpart of the bounded-radius primitive: there the uniformity came from the
range being bounded, here it comes from the decay of the amplitude over frequency.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory intervalIntegral Complex Set

namespace RHTower

/-- The convergent inverse-square tail from `2` is at most `1/2`. -/
theorem integral_inv_sq_le {X : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    (∫ x in (2 : ℝ)..X, (x ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX] at hx
    exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hx.1)
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -y⁻¹) ((x ^ 2)⁻¹) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hasDerivAt_inv (hpos x hx)).neg
    rwa [neg_neg] at h
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (x ^ 2)⁻¹) volume 2 X := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
    refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_pow 2) fun x hx => ?_
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (hpos x hx)
  have hftc : (∫ x in (2 : ℝ)..X, (x ^ 2)⁻¹) = -X⁻¹ - -(2 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hint
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hX
  have hXinv : 0 < X⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hXpos
  rw [hftc]
  norm_num
  linarith

/-- **The exterior primitive is uniformly bounded.**  With an antiderivative datum decaying like
`K/x` and a derivative decaying like `K/x²`, the oscillatory integral from `2` to any endpoint is
bounded by `3K/2`, with no dependence on the endpoint. -/
theorem norm_integral_cexp_le_of_decay
    {X K : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hK : 0 ≤ K) {φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ} {A B B' : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hφ : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, HasDerivAt B (B' x) x)
    (hB'c : ContinuousOn B' (Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X))
    (hAc : ContinuousOn A (Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X))
    (hrel : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, B x * (Complex.I * (φ' x : ℂ)) = A x)
    (hBdecay : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, ‖B x‖ ≤ K / x)
    (hB'decay : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (2 : ℝ) X, ‖B' x‖ ≤ K * (x ^ 2)⁻¹) :
    ‖∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, A t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * φ t)‖ ≤ 3 * K / 2 := by
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hX
  have hmain := norm_integral_cexp_le_of_antiderivative hX hφ hB hB'c hAc hrel
  -- the boundary terms
  have hbX : ‖B X‖ ≤ K / 2 := by
    refine le_trans (hBdecay X Set.right_mem_uIcc) ?_
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK (by norm_num) hX
  have hb2 : ‖B 2‖ ≤ K / 2 := hBdecay 2 Set.left_mem_uIcc
  -- the remaining integral
  have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖B' t‖) volume 2 X := hB'c.norm.intervalIntegrable
  have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => K * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) volume 2 X := by
    refine (ContinuousOn.mul continuousOn_const ?_).intervalIntegrable
    refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_pow 2) fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX] at hx
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hx.1))
  have htail : (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, ‖B' t‖) ≤ K / 2 := by
    have hmono : (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, ‖B' t‖) ≤ ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, K * (t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hX hi1 hi2 fun t ht => ?_
      exact hB'decay t (Set.uIcc_of_le hX ▸ ht)
    have hconst : (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, K * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) = K * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, (t ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul K _
    have hbase := integral_inv_sq_le hX
    have : K * (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..X, (t ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ K * (1 / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase hK
    rw [hconst] at hmono
    linarith
  linarith [hmain, hbX, hb2, htail]
